title: Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
title_zh: Top-k 检索使记忆价值无法被确定

paragraphs.en: 研究证明top-k检索使记忆价值不可辨识，提出LEDGER以闭式解估计可确定的Shapley值。 A memory-augmented agent must decide which memories to keep, merge and retrieve, and its only evidence of their value is its retrieval log: the memories it retrieved in each episode and whether it succeeded. Existing methods assign every memory a value from this log, even when the log cannot separate one memory's contribution from another's. We treat the log as an experiment that nobody designed and ask which memory values it determines. Two counts answer this before any outcome is observed: how often each memory was retrieved, and how often each pair was retrieved together. From these counts, we prove that top-$k$ retrieval leaves every memory value undetermined, however many episodes are logged, and that a question with its own memories, asked once, determines at most one of their values. On fourteen standard memory benchmarks, no memory value is determined in any of 55 configurations. Both causes are choices about retrieval. We introduce LEDGER, which estimates each determined Shapley value in closed form with a confidence interval and reports every other value as undetermined. It merges memories with identical histories without losing a determined value, and it retrieves so that the next log determines more. On pooled HotpotQA, LEDGER raises the fraction of memories determined from 0.001 to 0.797, at a cost of 2.6 accuracy points on HotpotQA and with a gain of 2.7 on LoCoMo.
paragraphs.zh: 研究证明top-k检索使记忆价值不可辨识，提出LEDGER以闭式解估计可确定的Shapley值。 一个带记忆增强的智能体必须决定保留、合并和检索哪些记忆，而其价值的唯一证据是它的检索日志：即它在每个情节中检索了哪些记忆以及是否成功。 现有方法从这份日志为每条记忆赋值，即使日志无法把一条记忆的贡献与另一条区分开来。 我们把这份日志当作一个无人设计过的实验，并追问它究竟能确定哪些记忆的价值。 两个计数在任何结果被观察到之前就能回答这个问题：每条记忆被检索的频率，以及每对记忆被一起检索的频率。 基于这些计数，我们证明top-$k$检索会使所有记忆价值都无法确定，无论记录了多少个情节；而一个带有自身记忆的问题即使只被问一次，也至多只能确定这些记忆中的一个的价值。 在十四个标准记忆基准上，55种配置中没有任何一个记忆价值被确定。 两者的原因都在于检索方式的选择。 我们提出LEDGER，它以闭式解估计每个可确定的Shapley值并给出置信区间，同时将所有其他值报告为不可确定。 它在不丢失任何已确定价值的前提下合并历史完全相同的记忆，并且通过调整检索方式使下一份日志能确定更多价值。 在汇总的HotpotQA上，LEDGER将记忆被确定的比例从0.001提升到0.797，代价是在HotpotQA上损失2.6个准确率点，同时在LoCoMo上获得2.7的提升。
